#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/lpessini/dev/software-factory
umask 077
native_config=$(mktemp /tmp/issue26-native.XXXXXX.json)
trap 'rm -f "$native_config"' EXIT
factory_cgroup=$(cut -d: -f3 /proc/self/cgroup)
jq -n --arg cgroup "/sys/fs/cgroup$factory_cgroup" \
  --arg provider "$PWD/.checks/issue28-provider/codex" \
  '{executable:$provider,bubblewrap:"/usr/bin/bwrap",cgroup_root:$cgroup,
    runtime_roots:["/usr"],auth_file:"/home/lpessini/.codex/auth.json",
    approval_policy:"on-request"}' > "$native_config"
printf 'Source: '
git rev-parse HEAD
sha256sum .checks/issue28-provider/codex .checks/issue28-provider/codex-code-mode-host /usr/bin/bwrap
DOCKER_HOST=unix:///tmp/issue26-docker-unavailable.sock \
  FACTORY_NATIVE_TEST_CONFIG="$native_config" FACTORY_NATIVE_TEST_MODEL=gpt-5.6-luna \
  cargo test --locked -p factory-runtime --test native_worker -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
